cases.case_label: De novo Alu in exon 8 of ZEB2 (Mowat-Wilson)
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo heterozygous Alu insertion in ZEB2 exon 8, confirmed by nanopore sequencing, creates a premature stop codon, likely causing haploinsufficiency.
cases.quote: Nanopore long-read sequencing confirmed the Alu insertion, leading to the formation of a premature stop codon and likely haploinsufficiency of ZEB2.
